data.one_liner: Flutter package that provides Eva Icons as IconData for easy use in apps.
data.what_it_does: It exposes over 480 Eva Icons as constants that can be used with Flutter's Icon widget. The package requires no additional setup beyond adding the dependency.
use_when: You need a ready‑made collection of vector icons without adding custom fonts
You want simple outlined or rounded icons for common UI actions
avoid_when: You require a different icon style or need SVG manipulation
You need runtime icon loading or theming beyond the provided set
weaknesses: No support for custom icon fonts or SVGs

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a widely used icon set with many styles and community support

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a different modern icon collection that may better match your design
